bass.tags: Solo acoustic bass performance. The upright bass utilizes a percussive slap technique where the strings are struck against the fingerboard to create a sharp, rhythmic click on the backbeat. The player alternates between low-register thumb-plucked notes and high-register finger-plucked accents. The performance features rapid chromatic runs and syncopated rhythmic patterns. The recording is dry with minimal room ambience, capturing the mechanical noise of the strings and the woody resonance of the instrument body. 110 BPM. Key of G minor. 4/4 time signature.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[percussive slap on upright bass strings, rhythmic clicking]

[Main Theme]
[syncopated low-register bass notes, thumb-plucked]
[high-register finger-plucked accents]
[chromatic descending bass line]

[Outro]
[final percussive string slap, resonant low G note]

drums.tags: Hard rock with heavy metal influences. Distorted electric guitars play palm-muted chugging riffs and power chords. A double-kick drum kit features rapid sixteenth-note kick patterns and aggressive snare hits. An overdriven electric bass guitar follows the guitar riffs. The track features a high-pitched male vocal with grit and occasional screams. 140 BPM. 4/4 time signature. Key of E minor. The arrangement utilizes frequent tempo-synced guitar stops and rapid-fire drum fills. Lead guitar sections incorporate wah-pedal filtering and fast alternate picking. High-gain distortion is applied to all string instruments.

vocals.tags: Traditional Irish Folk. Solo tin whistle in D major performing a lively jig in 6/8 time. The melody features rapid ornamentation including cuts, strikes, and rolls. The performance is monophonic with no accompaniment. The tempo is approximately 120 BPM. The whistle has a breathy, high-pitched timbre with natural acoustic resonance. Phrasing follows a standard AABB structure with repeated eight-bar sections. The articulation is sharp with distinct tonguing on the downbeats of the triplet groupings.
